description: Apply an SVG filter to items as a Live Effect (Effect > SVG Filters): one of the filters new documents carry (AI_Alpha_1, AI_Alpha_4, AI_BevelShadow_1, AI_CoolBreeze, AI_Dilate_3, AI_Dilate_6, AI_Erode_3, AI_Erode_6, AI_GaussianBlur_4, AI_GaussianBlur_7, AI_PixelPlay_1, AI_PixelPlay_2, AI_Shadow_1, AI_Shadow_2, AI_Static, AI_Turbulence_3, AI_Turbulence_5, AI_Woodgrain) or the name of another SVG filter in the document. The filter must exist in the document. Use expand to turn the result into plain artwork

expand.description: Expand the result (Object > Expand Appearance). Default false

method.description: effect (default) applies the filter to each item; menu runs the preset's Effect > SVG Filters command on the selection (built-in filters only)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: apply_svg_filter
title: Apply SVG Filter
